short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Hausa, in Divine Voice™ Color — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. A complete 66-book Hausa Bible (Littafi Mai Tsarki na Hausa), paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Wannan shi ne Littafi Mai Tsarki na farko da aka buga inda za ka iya ganin wanda yake magana. Kalmomin Ubanmu da launin SHUƊI, na Ɗan da launin JA, na Ruhu da launin SHUNAYYA.

Fiye da shekara ɗari, jajayen haruffa suna nuna inda Ɗan yake magana. Amma Ubanmu yana magana fiye da haka ƙwarai — a cikin wannan Littafi Mai Tsarki na Hausa kalmomi 132,156 a cikin ayoyi 5,609 — kuma har zuwa yanzu an buga dukan kalmominsa da baƙin tawada ɗaya kamar jerin zuriyoyi. Ya daɗe yana magana tun farko; babu Littafi Mai Tsarki da ya taɓa nuna maka inda.
Launin alama ce ta mallaka, ba ta ambato ba. Kalmomin Ubanmu suna zama nasa a kowane baki da yake ɗauke da su da aminci; kalmomin da bai taɓa faɗa ba ba a sa musu launi ba; labari yana zama baƙi.
Sa'ad da almajirai suka tambaya yadda za su yi addu'a, Ɗan ya ba su Uba: “Ya Ubanmu na Sama, a tsarkake sunanka” (Matiyu 6:9). Ta wurin Ruhu muke kira: “Abba! Uba!” (Romawa 8:15).
Shi ba mai nisa ba ne. Bai karaya da kai ba. Shi ne Ubanka na Sama, kai kuma ƙaunataccen ɗansa ne. In kalmar ‘uba’ ba kalmar ta'aziyya ba ce a gare ka, wannan Littafi Mai Tsarki naka ne musamman.
Cikakken Littafi Mai Tsarki a juzu'i ɗaya — littattafai 66, surori 1,189, ayoyi 31,087. Gabatarwa a kowane littafi, bayanai 1,361 domin mai karatu, da shafin keɓewa domin sunan wanda kake ba shi.
Fassara ce mai aminci daga ainihin Ibrananci, Aramiyanci da Hellenanci; ana fassara kowane bugu daga Father’s Heart Bible™. Murfin takarda da murfi mai tauri, an buga da launi.
Domin kowane iyali da ikkilisiya masu magana da Hausa — a arewacin Najeriya, a Nijar da ko'ina a Afirka ta Yamma — domin su ji muryar Uba da harshensu.
Karɓi Ubanka. Ji muryarsa. Zuciyarsa tana gare ka.

faq.q: Is the Hausa edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Hausa, 966 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Hausa edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Hausa edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Hausa text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Hausa Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/ha.
